description_excerpt: About The Role The Technical Sales Manager is responsible for driving the growth of Cummins Aftermarket business in Northern Vietnam through the sales of genuine spare parts, repair solutions, maintenance contracts, lubricants, filtration products, and value-added aftermarket services. This role combines technical sales, key account management, business development, and cross-functional collaboration with Engine, Power Generation, Service, and dealer partners to deliver sustainable business growth.
